message_en: Listing states no brand. Licensed character goods normally name the maker; treat as possible bootleg.

New/sealed item priced far below MSRP is unusual for this category; verify authenticity.

message_en: Listing or base photo shows no visible maker name or logo. Licensed figures and kuji prizes are normally marked; treat this as a point worth checking rather than proof either way.
Listing mentions print misalignment on acrylic art (acrylic stands/charms). This can be a sign of an unlicensed reproduction
source_url: but minor factory variance also occurs; compare against official product photos.

message_en: Listing mentions loose or uneven stitching on a plush. Sometimes reported for unlicensed plush
source_url: but this can also reflect wear on a genuine item; ask for close-up photos of the seams.

message_en: Plush or apparel listed with no maker tag. Licensed KH plush is normally tagged
source_url: so a missing tag is worth asking about
column5: though tags are also commonly removed or lost on genuine items.
